title: Probing and steering biology across Boltz-1s trunk-diffusion boundary
abstract: arXiv:2608.11475v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AlphaFold3-class structure predictors pair a representational trunk, which processes sequence and context, with a diffusion module, which generates atomic coordinates. How biological information changes as it crosses this architectural boundary remains poorly understood. We analyze per-residue activations from the Pairformer trunk and diffusion module of Boltz-1 using linear probes, sparse autoencoders (SAEs), and causal interventions. From the trunk, both geometry (secondary structure, disorder) and sequence chemistry (amino-acid identity, signal peptides, disulfide-bond annotations) are linearly decodable. In the diffusion module, the two diverge. Secondary structure transfers essentially unchanged, whereas sequence chemistry is strongly attenuated. We then test whether decodable directions can steer the model, intervening on the final trunk single representation that conditions the diffusion module. Helix and coil directions change

translated_title: 在Boltz-1的躯干-扩散边界上探测与引导生物学信息
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.11475v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：AlphaFold3类结构预测器将表征躯干（处理序列和上下文）与扩散模块（生成原子坐标）配对。生物学信息在跨越这一架构边界时如何变化仍知之甚少。我们使用线性探针、稀疏自编码器（SAEs）和因果干预，分析了Boltz-1中Pairformer躯干和扩散模块的逐残基激活。从躯干中，几何信息（二级结构、无序性）和序列化学信息（氨基酸身份、信号肽、二硫键注释）均可线性解码。在扩散模块中，两者出现分化。二级结构几乎不变地传递，而序列化学信息则被强烈衰减。随后，我们测试了可解码的方向是否能引导模型，对最终条件化扩散模块的躯干单一表征进行干预。螺旋和卷曲方向发生变化。
tldr: 该研究揭示了Boltz-1模型中，躯干编码的序列化学信息在扩散模块中被衰减，而几何结构信息保持传递，并通过干预躯干表征实现了对结构生成的引导。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that sequence chemistry encoded in the trunk is attenuated in the diffusion module of Boltz-1, while geometric structure information transfers unchanged, and intervention on trunk representations enables steering of structure generation.
